acceptanceCriteria: The lane finish path (or an installable pre-push hook) runs make windows-vet when Go inputs changed and refuses on failure.
A test shows a unix-only helper reference is refused before push.
body: Residual from V1-1719 (PR #1098, AFP-V0-054). `corvint affected` lists `conditional make windows-vet` and AGENTS.md mentions it, but no pre-push hook, finish-lane recipe or local gate runs it, so an agent that skips the advisory still burns a CI round (V1-1092, PR #1089 class). Expected: the lane finish recipe (dogfood-finish or batch-check) or an opt-in pre-push hook runs it when .go/go.mod/go.sum change.
title: make windows-vet is advisory only: nothing runs it before push, so Windows vet failures still reach CI
